text_4555f0787f33: In My account → GPS settings choose the stop threshold (1, 2, 4, 5, 10 or 15 minutes), your marker and visible details. The threshold is saved when recording starts; existing recordings retain theirs. Manual stops remain available. Sharing defaults to No. Yes and Save permit sharing. Only pressing Share during an active recording starts transmission: one current position, then at most every five minutes. Stop sharing, ending the recording or selecting No ends sharing. Android continues sharing with the background recorder. Browser transmission depends on the browser continuing to run. Old positions are not replayed after an outage. After ten minutes without a current position the marker disappears for others. Others see a detail only when both parties select it; your checkboxes also control your own map.
text_9534ef329eb0: Personal GPS settings, four additional marker icons and explicitly started sharing of current positions every five minutes.
text_56821ac555f7: In My account → GPS settings the five marker icons look exactly like the map markers. Select the radio button below the desired icon and save. GPS demo uses your saved marker, display checkboxes and stop threshold. You can change settings and reload the recording in the demo; the original recording remains unchanged. Sharing applies only to real active recordings, not playback. Above the GPS icon, elapsed time and stopped time appear as hours:minutes without labels, for example 02:15 / 00:30. Total time since departure is on the left and accumulated stopped time on the right. If only one value is selected, it appears alone without a slash. This applies to recording and demo playback. Steam locomotive, diesel locomotive, electric locomotive and tank wagon use the supplied original PNG images at a proportional display size. The same images appear on the map, in the picker and in the GPS demo. The circle remains available. Image backgrounds remain transparent on the map, in settings and in the demo; the light backing has been removed.
